item.title: eMudhra Revokes 8 More CAs It Previously Declared Unaffected by Key Compromise

item.title: Microsoft Researchers Show AI Agents Can Be Backdoored by Editing Fewer Than 10 Neurons
item.description: An AI model can be given a hidden backdoor by editing fewer than 10 of its rarely used neurons, without retraining the model, Microsoft researchers have shown.
